name: Katipunan Condo Dorm at One Burgundy Plaza
address: 7th Floor, One Burgundy Plaza, 307 Katipunan Avenue, Loyola Heights, across Ateneo
description: Condo-style bedspaces on the 7th floor of a Katipunan building directly facing Ateneo. Rent is all-in, covering internet, electricity for gadgets and use of the building gym. Within reach of Ateneo, Miriam, UP Diliman and CCA.

name: Athena Ladies Dorm
address: Rosa Alvero St., beside McDonald's Katipunan, Loyola Heights
description: A furnished ladies-only dorm a few meters off Katipunan Avenue, close to Ateneo, Miriam and UP Diliman. Every room has its own comfort room and WiFi, with a choice of 4 or 6 sharing; a 2-person room costs more.

name: Female Bedspaces in Loyola Heights
address: Across Loyola Heights Barangay Hall (Park 9), Loyola Heights, Katipunan
description: A women's boarding house in a safe, walkable pocket of Loyola Heights near Miriam, Ateneo, UP Diliman and Cubao. Rooms have private bathrooms, and there is a shared dining and living room downstairs. Visitors are allowed.

name: Male Bedspace on C. Benitez St., Cubao
address: C. Benitez St., Cubao, near MRT Cubao and Farmers Plaza
description: Budget bedspaces for men a short walk from MRT Cubao, Gateway Mall and SM Cubao. Six sleep to a room, each room has its own comfort room and sink, and CCTV covers every floor. Light cooking is allowed but rice cookers are not.
houseRules: No curfew; no rice cookers; WiFi is a separate fee per gadget

name: Male Bedspace near Araneta Center
address: Near MRT Cubao, Araneta Center, Cubao
description: Quiet and secured bedspaces for men next to the MRT, LRT, EDSA and SM Cubao. Double-deck beds with foam and an electric fan, plus a laundry area. Light and water are included in the monthly fee.

name: UP Bliss Building Rooms
address: UP Bliss Building, behind Jollibee Philcoa, Diliman, near Maginhawa and Technohub
description: Solo rooms in a building behind Philcoa, walkable to UP Diliman, Technohub, Maginhawa and QC City Hall. The rate includes 100 Mbps WiFi, electricity and water, kitchenware is provided, and cooking and laundry are allowed. Minimum stay of six months.
houseRules: 1 month advance and 1 month deposit; minimum 6-month stay; 2 valid IDs; no big appliances

name: Flying Lemur Dormitel
address: Katipunan Avenue, Loyola Heights, next to CCA
description: An air-conditioned dormitel on Katipunan Avenue that takes both men and women as bedspacers or transients. WiFi and a refrigerator are provided, and a security deposit is required. Close to Ateneo, Miriam and UP Diliman.

name: Male Bedspace on Matimtiman St., Teachers Village
address: 84-M Matimtiman St., Teachers Village, Diliman, near Philcoa and Maginhawa
description: Six-to-a-room bedspaces for men in Teachers Village, a short ride from UP Diliman, Philcoa and Maginhawa. Rent covers light and water, a bed, fan, refrigerator and a stove with gas. Toilet and bath are shared.

name: Female Boarding House, 7th Avenue Cubao
address: 87 7th Avenue, Cubao, 4 houses from P. Tuazon, Araneta City
description: A newly opened boarding house for women in a peaceful compound three minutes on foot from SM, Ali Mall, Farmers and Gateway. All beds come with foam, and water and electricity are included in the rent.
